title: Loop basics
summary: Trace the first check of a while loop and reason about when its body runs.
statement: Fix the program so the loop body never runs and it prints Done. Before running, predict the value of count at the first while check.

specification.input: No standard input. The starting value of count is initialized in the program.
specification.output: Print Done followed by a newline without executing the loop body.
specification.constraints: Keep the program as a single-file C++17 program.

checkpoints.question: What is the value of count at the first while check?
